subject: Need to reschedule call due to missing attachment
text:
Hello everyone,

Thank you for making time for the follow-up call scheduled for later this afternoon. After reviewing the support packet sent earlier, I noticed that the attachment referenced in the agenda was not included, which makes it difficult to complete a full review before we meet. Rather than meeting under incomplete conditions, I would like to propose moving the call to a new time once the missing file has been shared.

I hope this does not cause too much inconvenience on your side. The goal is simply to make the discussion more efficient and ensure everyone can address the same details without waiting for a mid-meeting upload. Please let me know if tomorrow morning works better, or if you would prefer late afternoon after the attachment has had a chance to arrive. If a shorter interim check-in would help, I can also reserve fifteen minutes now and move the longer conversation.

During that first meeting, I can confirm the revised time, recap open items, and make sure we are aligned on remaining risks. I will also copy relevant notes into the project board once the file is in place.

Please reply with two slots you could protect, and I will confirm the revised invite once the correct file reaches my inbox. In the meantime, I will keep the current support draft on hold and pause any internal steps that depend on the missing document. I apologize for any short-notice change and appreciate your patience while we align the materials before the next discussion.
